main.title: How do you make a switch out of a rock?
main.description:
Build your own transistor in the interactive lesson: https://loathwine.github.io/tricked-rocks/lessons/02-the-switch/

Your phone has about twenty billion switches, and not one of them moves. They're made of silicon, the main ingredient of sand. In this video we go from electricity itself, through relays and vacuum tubes, to the transistor: a switch made of a rock.

0:00 A switch out of a rock?
0:38 What is electricity, really?
1:38 Switches that decide
2:07 Relays: switches flipped by electricity
3:02 Vacuum tubes: no moving parts
3:45 Silicon, and doping it
4:24 Building a transistor
5:17 Why the transistor won
5:50 Switches flipping switches

Numbers are rounded, chosen to show the scale rather than exact figures.
Narration: AI voice (Gemini TTS). Visuals and sound are generated in code.
